policy: Everything ships as CC0 1.0 (docs/level-builder/spec.md section 10). Tiny Speck's library decos are CC0 1.0. New art, Austin's own work or AI-generated, is dedicated CC0 1.0 with its provenance recorded: who or what made it, and from what inputs. Inputs must be CC0 (library decos) or Austin's own work. Third-party packs (CC-BY and other sites) are not used.

kinds.deco: a Tiny Speck library deco by name (deco:bush_3); it must be in the library
kinds.own: Austin's own work, described (own:pencil sketch of a mossy stump)
